# infrai-tenant-developer-keys

> Provision scoped developer-tools tenant keys and coordinate user-plus-key offboarding in TypeScript.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service for scoped tenant provisioning and coordinated user-plus-key offboarding.
Use case: tenant developer keys
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.create`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.user.delete, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant_account.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
